P0-1_per_fold_label_regeneration.v1_issue: Builder split old combined teacher labels by task without re-running teacher.label_trajectory() with fold-specific config

P0-4_heldout_label_materialization.v1_issue: No path defined for generating test teacher labels from fold-specific frozen teacher config

P1-2_calibration_fail_closed.v1_issue: if os.path.exists() could silently skip missing paths
P1-2_calibration_fail_closed.v2_fix: assert len(train_paths) == 400, assert per-task count == 50, FileNotFoundError on missing path

P1-3_single_truth_source.v1_issue: FOLD_MATRIX duplicated in JSON, CSV, and builder
P1-3_single_truth_source.v2_fix: FOLD_MATRIX defined in build_sc5_loto_fold_v2.py as single source. Protocol JSON references builder.
